title: Singleton isomorphisms cover in the colimit precoverage
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], a strict diagram $F:J\to\mathit{Cat}$, and $P_j$ precoverages on its stages. Assume each $P_j$ contains singleton isomorphisms, is stable under finite indexed composition and finite indexed base change [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage], and has pullbacks of its covering arrows. Every covering presieve has finite uncurried arrow set. Every transition functor maps covering presieves to covering presieves and preserves the pullback of a covering arrow along any arrow. Let $V$ be a cocone whose object and arrow cocones [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor] are colimits of sets, and let $Q$ be a precoverage on its vertex. Assume a presieve $R$ on $Y$ belongs to $Q$ exactly when there are a stage $j$, an object $X$, a covering $S$ of $P_j$ on $X$, and an equality $V_j(X)=Y$ such that transport of $S.map(V_j)$ along that equality is $R$. Then every singleton presieve of an isomorphism belongs to $Q$.

proof.text: Given an isomorphism f in the cocone category, represent f and its inverse using joint surjectivity of the arrow colimit. Move them to a common stage by filteredness. Their endpoint equalities hold in the object colimit; eventual equality moves to a later stage where the endpoints match literally. Transport the arrows along these equalities. The two inverse equations hold in the arrow colimit, so eventual equality and a common refinement make both hold at one further stage. Functoriality preserves these equations under refinement. The resulting stage arrow is an isomorphism, and its singleton is covering by (P j).HasIsos. A functor maps its singleton presieve to the singleton of its image. The equality of image arrows includes both endpoints, so transporting this singleton along the target equality gives exactly the singleton of f. The reverse implication in hQ makes that singleton a Q-cover. This proves Q.HasIsos. If the cocone category is empty there is no f to check.

theorem colimit_site_covering_axioms_HasIsos
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    (hQ : (∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
          ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X) (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
            S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R)) :
        Q.HasIsos
